info.name: Lavalite Core API - Complete Collection
info.description:
**Comprehensive API collection for Lavalite Multi-Organization ERP Core Microservice**

## Features Covered:
- 🔐 Authentication (JWT)
- 👤 User Management
- 🏢 Organizations
- 🎭 Roles & Permissions
- 👥 Teams
- 📦 Modules
- 💳 Billing
- 🛡️ Security (2FA, Email Verification, Password Reset)

## Base URL
`http://localhost:8000/api`

## Environment Variables Required:
- `base_url` - API base URL
- `jwt_token` - Auto-populated on login
- `current_organization_id` - Auto-populated on login

## Demo Credentials:
- **Super Admin:** john@lavalite.org | password
- **Moderator:** jane@lavalite.org | password
- **User:** bob@lavalite.org | password

**Version:** 2.0.0  
**Last Updated:** November 13, 2025

item.name: 🔐 Authentication
item.description: JWT-based authentication endpoints with multi-organization support

request.description: Register a new user with enhanced profile fields

Login with email and password. Organization ID is optional - if not provided, uses first organization. To specify organization, add: "organization_id": "9d5c88e7-1234-5678-9abc-123456789012" (must be valid UUID)
Get authenticated user information with current organization context

Refresh JWT access token using refresh token. The refresh token can be provided in two ways:

1. **Request Body** (shown here): Pass `refresh_token` in JSON body
2. **HTTP-only Cookie**: The refresh_token cookie is automatically set on login for web apps

The endpoint returns:
- New access_token (JWT)
- New refresh_token (rotated for security)
- User information
- Organization context
- Roles and permissions

Refresh tokens expire after 14 days.
Logout and blacklist current token
Switch to a different organization (gets new JWT with new context)

Get comprehensive role details including:
- Basic role information (id, name, slug, description)
- is_global flag (true for system roles)

Response includes all relationships and statistics needed for role details page.
